_meta.source: BIR — Tax Code (NIRC) and revenue regulations

codes.name: VAT Output 12%
codes.description: Standard VAT on sale of goods, properties, services. NIRC Sec. 106-108.

codes.name: VAT Input 12%
codes.description: Creditable input VAT on purchases of goods/services.

codes.name: VAT Input — Deferred (Capital)
codes.description: Capital goods ≥ ₱1M: input VAT amortized over 60 months. NIRC Sec. 110(A).

codes.name: VAT Zero-Rated
codes.description: Export sales, sales to PEZA, etc. NIRC Sec. 106(A)(2).

codes.name: VAT Exempt
codes.description: Senior citizen / PWD discount, agricultural products in original state, etc. NIRC Sec. 109.

codes.name: VAT Withheld — Government Sales
codes.description: Final 5% VAT withheld by government on payments to suppliers. NIRC Sec. 114(C).

codes.name: Percentage Tax — 3%
codes.description: Non-VAT taxpayers on gross sales/receipts. NIRC Sec. 116. (Reduced to 1% July 2020 — Jun 2023 by RA 11534 CREATE.)

codes.name: Excise — Petroleum
codes.description: Per-liter excise tax on petroleum products. Computed by volume; rate varies by product.
